title: environment.visual
description: Universal visual stimulus for bot input vision abilities.

image.description: Reference (a URI reference) to the image this stimulus carries; floppy passes media by reference, never as bytes [floppy field].
image.title: Image

media_type.description: Optional media type for the image bytes, such as image/png or image/jpeg.
media_type.title: Media Type

kind.description: Optional low-cardinality visual provenance hint (for example camera, screen).
kind.title: Kind

source.description: Optional visual source: the transducer this view came off (a camera, a screen capture), as its emitter stamps it. The original carries it as the visual event's source; an SCXML event relayed through the body keeps only its data, so floppy carries it in the view [floppy field]. Seeing holds the newest view of each source and drops a view without one.
source.title: Source

participants.description: Who produced this stimulus, stamped by the device that emitted it. Empty when the device knows no one (ambient sound, an unattended camera).

items.description: Someone who took part in a stimulus: an opaque, producer-stable identity reference and the role it played (source: who produced it; target: who it was addressed to).

ref.description: Opaque, producer-stable identity such as a phone number, an app person id, or a chat handle. Never a display name chosen by the bot.
ref.title: Ref

role.description: source: who produced the stimulus (speaker, sender). target: who it was addressed to.
role.title: Role

items.title: Participant

participants.title: Participants
